name: Captain Cook

intro.text: I landed here in January 1775, claimed the lot for King George III, and left a note on how dreadful it was. Which part would you like to argue?

win: A sound drubbing. Put me down as pleasantly surprised, and don't tell the Admiralty.
after: I looked for the great southern continent and found a very large rock. Then a bigger one. Let nobody say I didn't try.
